description: This is a Python source file that sets up and runs a conversational AI bot pipeline integrating speech processing, language modeling, and external services. It defines an asynchronous function to initialize components like speech-to-text, text-to-speech, and language models, constructs a pipeline with transport mechanisms and event handlers for client connections, and finally runs the pipeline. The script is intended to be executed as a main program and includes environment setup, external library imports, and configuration details.

classes.description: Handles aggregation of user and assistant responses in the conversation context.

classes.description: Defines the sequence of processing steps in the conversational pipeline.

classes.description: Configuration parameters for a pipeline task.

classes.description: Executes the pipeline with proper handling of signals and events.

classes.description: Abstract class for transport mechanisms handling input/output.
